description: RSI, MACD, Bollinger %B, ATR, EMA trend and volume rank on Hyperliquid's 15-minute candles for one coin, plus the current funding rate. Use as inputs to your own decision; it is not a trading recommendation. ATR is useful for placing a stop. Not for live quotes (use compare_perp_quotes_across_venues). Input: symbol (base coin). Prices in USD per coin. Next: size_position_by_risk.
